findings.title: Debug mode enabled
findings.message: APP_DEBUG is enabled in a production environment
findings.remediation: Set APP_DEBUG=false (and NODE_ENV=production) for every deployed environment.

findings.title: pull_request_target checks out untrusted code
findings.message: Checks out the pull request head
findings.remediation: Use the pull_request trigger, or never check out or run code from the PR head.

findings.title: .env file committed or not ignored
findings.remediation: Add the file to .gitignore, then remove it from git with `git rm --cached`.

findings.title: Weak or empty application secret
findings.remediation: Generate a random value of at least 32 characters (Laravel: `php artisan key:generate`).

findings.title: Untrusted input interpolated into a shell step
findings.message: Untrusted input is used inside run:
findings.remediation: Assign the value to an env: variable and reference it as $VAR in the script.

findings.title: Debug mode enabled
findings.remediation: Set APP_DEBUG=false (and NODE_ENV=production) for every deployed environment.

findings.title: Laravel CORS allows every origin
findings.remediation: List the allowed origins in config/cors.php instead of '*'.

findings.title: Sensitive file in Laravel public directory
findings.remediation: Move the file out of public/ and delete any copy that was already deployed.

findings.title: .env file committed or not ignored
findings.remediation: Add the file to .gitignore, then remove it from git with `git rm --cached`.

findings.title: Weak or empty application secret
findings.remediation: Generate a random value of at least 32 characters (Laravel: `php artisan key:generate`).

findings.title: README missing or nearly empty
findings.remediation: Describe what the project does, how to install, run and test it.

findings.title: No automated tests detected
findings.message: No test files or test directories found
findings.remediation: Add a test runner (Jest/Vitest, PHPUnit/Pest) and cover the critical paths.

findings.title: Workflow token permissions too broad
findings.message: No permissions block, the token gets default access
findings.remediation: Add `permissions: contents: read` at the top and grant more per job only.

findings.title: Action not pinned to a commit SHA
findings.message: shivammathur/setup-php@v2 is not pinned to a SHA
findings.remediation: Pin the action to a full commit SHA and keep a version comment.

findings.title: Base image not pinned to a version
findings.remediation: Pin the image to a specific version tag, or better a digest (image@sha256:...).

findings.title: Container runs as root
findings.message: The final stage never switches away from root
findings.remediation: Create an unprivileged user and switch to it with a USER instruction.

findings.title: Lockfile missing or out of sync
findings.remediation: Commit the lockfile (npm install / composer install) and keep it in sync.

findings.title: Unpinned dependency version
findings.remediation: Use a bounded range (^1.2.3) or an exact version.

findings.title: Laravel session cookie not hardened
findings.message: Session cookie is not marked secure
findings.remediation: In config/session.php set secure=true, http_only=true and same_site='lax'.

findings.title: Laravel session cookie not hardened
findings.message: Session cookie is readable by scripts
findings.remediation: In config/session.php set secure=true, http_only=true and same_site='lax'.

findings.title: No rate limiting on Laravel auth routes
findings.message: Authentication routes have no throttle middleware
findings.remediation: Apply the throttle middleware or RateLimiter::for() to authentication routes.

findings.title: No license
findings.remediation: Add a LICENSE file (choosealicense.com can help you pick one).

findings.title: .gitignore missing or incomplete
findings.remediation: Add a .gitignore for your stack that covers dependencies, build output and .env.

findings.title: .env.example missing or incomplete
findings.remediation: Create .env.example with every key from .env and placeholder values.

findings.title: CI installs dependencies without caching
findings.message: Dependencies are installed without a cache
findings.remediation: Use `cache:` on setup-node/setup-python/setup-php or add actions/cache.

findings.title: Action not pinned to a commit SHA
findings.message: actions/checkout@v4 is not pinned to a SHA
findings.remediation: Pin the action to a full commit SHA and keep a version comment.

findings.title: Laravel optimization caches not built on deploy
findings.message: Deploy scripts never cache config, routes or views
findings.remediation: Run `php artisan optimize` (or config:cache, route:cache, view:cache) during deploy.

findings.title: No .dockerignore
findings.remediation: Add a .dockerignore listing .git, node_modules, .env and build output.

findings.title: No HEALTHCHECK
findings.message: The final stage has no HEALTHCHECK
findings.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction that calls a lightweight endpoint.

findings.title: Dependency install after copying the whole project
findings.remediation: COPY only the manifest and lockfile, install dependencies, then COPY the rest.

findings.title: Development tool in production dependencies
findings.remediation: Move it to devDependencies (npm) or require-dev (Composer).

findings.title: Laravel session cookie not hardened
findings.message: same_site is not set to lax or strict
findings.remediation: In config/session.php set secure=true, http_only=true and same_site='lax'.
